# CastLogic by IntraSync Industrial

> IntraSync Industrial is the maker of **CastLogic**, an AI-native, cloud-based ERP platform built specifically for **precast concrete manufacturing**. CastLogic connects estimating, production, yard, dispatch, quality control, accounting, and HR/payroll integration in one system — replacing paper, spreadsheets, and disconnected legacy tools. Founded in 2024 by Zachary Frye (Mechanical Engineering background, 7+ years of precast industry experience). Member of the National Precast Concrete Association (NPCA), the Precast/Prestressed Concrete Institute (PCI), and the Canadian Precast Concrete Institute (CPCI).

## What CastLogic is

- **Category:** ERP software for precast concrete manufacturers (architectural, structural, utility, and pipe segments).
- **Deployment:** Cloud-based / web.
- **Who it's for:** Precast plants currently running on paper, spreadsheets, or aging legacy systems that want one integrated system from quote to cash.
- **Core promise:** Eliminate duplicate data entry, reduce errors and rework, crash manual production scheduling time, and give real-time visibility across the plant.

## Products

CastLogic is sold as two products on one platform, scaled to company size:

- **CastLogic Production** — estimating through dispatch and the field: Bidding & Estimating, Designer (structure design and drawings), Engage (CAD/BIM engineering data), Schedule, Flow (production tracking), Verify (quality control), Stock (yard and inventory), Dispatch, and Site (field/project management). Designer and QC are included.
- **CastLogic Accounting** — GL, AP/AR, project accounting, and job costing. Sold on its own or with Production.
- **Included with both:** Insights (analytics) and AI.
- **Integrations (not separate modules):** CastLogic integrates with HR/payroll platforms (e.g., BambooHR, Rippling, Paylocity, Time Track Plus) and with modern external accounting systems (e.g., QuickBooks, Sage, NetSuite, SAP, Oracle), with data flowing both ways. Plants can run Production with their existing accounting system.

Other IntraSync product lines:
- **BatchLogic** — Batch control for concrete production.
- **MaterialsLogic** — Aggregates/materials ERP.

Related engineering tooling: **DesignLogic** — Revit/AutoCAD plugins for drafting and shop-drawing workflows.

## Pricing

Custom pricing based on company size and the module groups selected. Fixed monthly subscription; one-time implementation fee waived for plants of 50 employees or fewer. Contact IntraSync for a quote. An interactive ROI calculator is available at /roi-calculator.html.

## Implementation & support

- **Onboarding:** Deployed in six months or less (discovery, configuration and data staging, UAT/training/go-live, post-go-live support) with dedicated implementation specialists.
- **Support:** Live technical assistance 6am–6pm PST, Monday–Friday, with a 1-hour response target for critical issues. Dedicated account managers, training, and knowledge base.

## How CastLogic compares

CastLogic positions as a modern, integrated alternative to legacy precast systems including **BETSY**, **Titan3000**, **IDAT-ERP**, and **IMPACT Production**. Detailed feature-by-feature comparison: /compare.html Compared with **Protrak** (Prorigo Software), a general low-code platform configured for precast and billed per user, CastLogic is purpose-built for precast, includes estimating, structure design (Designer), and accounting, and has unlimited seats. **CastLogic Verify** (QC, included in CastLogic Production) can replace standalone precast QC tools such as **Idencia** (Aiden) and **EXACT Technology** (xTrack), keeping inspection results in the same system as scheduling, yard, dispatch, and job cost.
